name: what a competency is
value: an operational verb (placed on the taxonomy by the verb table) plus the knowledge it acts on; the statement names no tool

name: how the knowledge of a competency is read from its phrases
note: the shared head of the objects; a word-order rule, no part-of-speech tagger

name: cognitive level of a competency
value: read from the verbs the postings use (C1-C6); never from a default verb supplied by the method; phrases without a verb form a competency with no level

note: the number of clusters is a setting, not a discovery

name: SKKNI parser
note: every SKKNI PDF in DATA/master_skkni, whatever its year

name: how a competency statement is formulated
value: like an SKKNI unit title: an operational verb on the competency's level, the specific object of work, and the standard, quality and outcome its postings ask for; no tool names. The competencies come from the postings, not from SKKNI
note: the promotors' definition and the researcher's correction, 2026-11-20

name: SKKNI wording in a statement
value: used when a competency IS an SKKNI unit; only when the SKKNI title's verb is on the competency's level (otherwise both levels are shown)
note: the researcher: 'you might use the SKKNI wordings'; the level condition is the developer's

name: a 'same as SKKNI' decision needs a second model
value: the writer's 'sama' stands only when a second model, shown the competency and that one unit and nothing the writer decided, also says 'sama'; otherwise it becomes 'sebagian' and the market's statement is kept
note: the developer's rule: the writer alone was wrong in 4 of its 10 'sama' calls on the development sample (EXP-032)

name: second model for the 'same as SKKNI' decision
note: another family than the writer (GPT) and than the reference judges (Claude); one definition of 'sama' is shared by both prompts
